acceptanceCriteria: Keep the fixture-only scope explicit; do not characterize the older adapter refusal as a production task-context regression.
If policy/1 fixture preview is needed, qualify both supported profile versions and malformed/unknown profile refusals; otherwise retain its explicit /0-only contract.
body:
V1-0462 introduces explicit taskman-policy/1 for opted-in external review. The existing Core task-context reader internal/taskman/capture.go:269 closes the policy field set, and line278 explicitly requires taskman-policy/0. The Tasks builder confirms opted-in queues therefore remain unsupported by this separate consumer; older-reader refusal is intentional, not evidence of unsafe acceptance. Qualify whether whole-product task-context use requires upgrading this in-tree consumer, and retain an explicit limitation until supported. No Core parser change or product failure was claimed by the V1-0462 slice. Evidence: frozen Tasks source8da24a4fa37063f53ca595fadee2fd4004cd8bfc and /tmp/corvint-tasks-review-20260929/accepted-contract.patch. This is an observed compatibility boundary, not a new release blocker by assumption.

CORRECTION 2026-09-29 after call-site tracing: this is the fixture-only adapter, not general Core task-context. cmd/corvint/taskman_fixture.go:15 invokes taskman.Preview; internal/taskman/capture.go:216 explicitly describes native fixture planning, lines245/250 refuse nonfixture sources, and line330 emits corvint-taskman-fixture-plan/0. General cmd/corvint/taskcontext.go does not call this package. The initial production/task-context attribution was incorrect. No production regression or additional 1.0 blocker is established; only future fixture-preview policy/1 compatibility remains a question.
title: Fixture task planning: document the policy/1 compatibility boundary
